d:
I separated the old stuff from the new, since I figured many people would prefer not downloading a single 2000 image gallery with a bunch of images they don't want. And those who do can just combine them. The cutoff is at an arbitrary and subjective point. These two are replacing my years old gallery.

This doesn't include most of his Pokemon species illustrations. I've made a separate gallery for those as well, seeing as there are almost 800 of them.
